subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Promotion Conversation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Promotion Conversation.

hook.text: He waited four years for a promotion that never came. His colleague asked directly in year two and got it.

buildup.text: Promotions rarely happen by osmosis. They require explicit conversations about what is needed and when.

discovery.text: The key question is: 'What specific gaps do I need to close to be considered for the next level?'

twist.text: Your boss may not have the full power to promote you. Understanding the process reveals who else needs convincing.

climax.text: Have the conversation early. Get the criteria in writing. Close the gaps visibly. Then ask again with evidence.

punchline.text: Ask for the criteria. Close the gaps. Then ask again.

quiz.question: What is the most important question to ask about promotion?
options: When will the next promotion cycle happen?
What specific gaps do I need to close for the next level?
How many years do I need to wait?
